provenance.note: INTRODUCED: escapePackageNameInPath is new in this PR and rewrites the captured package name with url.QueryEscape and a blind strings.Replace on the raw path, so a name the caller already percent-escaped has its percent sign encoded again (%2F becomes %252F) and the packages endpoint answers 404; issue #10592 is one of the two regressions PR #10630 names when it reverts this change, and the base has no such rewrite

keywords: an already escaped name is escaped again
the percent sign of a pre-escaped name is encoded twice
an already escaped name no longer resolves
callers that already encoded the name break
bugs.note: the helper escapes the captured name as if it were raw text, and replaces the first textual occurrence in the path, so input that is already escaped keeps its own escapes and gains new ones
